facts.business: Jayatma Industries Limited (formerly Santaram Spinners Ltd) is engaged in manufacturing activities at its plant in Mehsana, Gujarat.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include sitting fees paid to independent directors (Rajan Parikh: Rs 0.11 lakh, Premal Joshi: Rs 0.11 lakh), remuneration to CFO Mayank Thaker (Rs 7.50 lakh) and CS Ziral Soni (Rs 1.72 lakh), rent payable to Dhariniben Kalyanbhai Shah (Rs 3.00 lakh), licence usage fees to Kalyanbhai J Shah HUF (Rs 0.65 lakh), and rent expense to Dimple Niravbhai Shah. Closing balances outstanding as on 31st March 2026: Mayank Thaker Rs 0.64 lakh, Ziral Soni Rs 0.15 lakh, Dhariniben Kalyanbhai Shah Rs 3.00 lakh, Kalyanbhai J Shah HUF Rs 6.59 lakh, Dimple Niravbhai Shah Rs 2.48 lakh.
